fusions.name: Vice Shut
fusions.desc: Clamps down on the target for 16 damage and uses up every affliction you have on it, dealing 50% more damage for each one. It leaves the target 20% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Unhurried Overhand
fusions.desc: After a 1.5-second wind-up, strikes everything in a cone 3 tiles long for 16 damage and stuns it for 1.6 seconds, with a 60% chance to leave each [Bleeding] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Still as a Log
fusions.desc: After a 2-second cast, increases your damage by 40% for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Patience Rewarded
fusions.desc: When your stamina fills, your physical damage rises 30% for 5 seconds. Once every 15 seconds.
